grading_system.evidence: Twenty-Four (24) credits are required for a Spaulding diploma. Students must complete all graduation requirements and graduation proficiencies as determined by the BUUSD.
grading_system.proficiency_scale: 0-4 point scale (teachers indicate level of proficiency)

schedule.evidence: The Spaulding Band meets every day during our AM block (p.48). Semester-long courses are listed throughout (e.g. WBL300, p.58). Number of courses taken at once is not stated.

credit_definition.text: Semester-long course listed as 1 credit; year-long courses listed as 2 credits; some semester courses are 0.5 credit (e.g. band, chorus).
credit_definition.evidence: WBL300 - Site Experience, 1 Credit. This elective is a semester-long course (internship).

course_load.evidence: Sophomore status requires minimum of 6 completed credits; Junior status requires minimum of 12 completed credits; Senior status requires minimum of 18 completed credits.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Catalog states 24 credits; course listings use the standard credit unit (semester course = 1 credit, year-long = 2). Required areas: English 4, Social Studies 3.5 (incl. .5 Civics), Science 3, Math 3, PE 1.5, Health 0.5, Arts 1 (visual arts or music), Financial Literacy 0.5, electives 7. Also 40 hours community service (10 per school year).

flexible_pathways_listed: personalized flexible pathway (independent study with a teacher)
dual enrollment (CCV concurrent courses and traditional)

notes: Required local courses: Financial Literacy (BUS106, 0.5 credit) for all students. Community service: 10 hours per school year, minimum 40 hours total (adopted by school board 2018). Graduation requires proficiencies per BUUSD policy. Courses graded on proficiency-based 0-4 scale. Dual enrollment: two vouchers available to juniors and seniors. Virtual High School is described as an option for classes not offered at SHS or schedule conflicts; the catalog does not state its credit limits.
